description:
The quote that exits `account`'s open position in `instrument` before expiry: reads the position, takes the opposite
        side (long -> sell, short -> buy), size = min(|position|, quantity or the whole position), and returns the desk's signed
        quote with the fillOrderAs calldata in fill.send. You must send it with your own key before validUntil
        (`hedgehood close <instrument> --send` or the npm MCP's close_position); this server never sends. nothing_to_close
        when the account is flat there; a close_only:* refusal from the desk is returned with its reason.
name: close_quote
